note: source/app is the app's own production build (npm run build in toyz-motion-kit); it is not committed. The same screens are live at https://motion-kit.toyz.kr. Animation frames are the app's own snippet animations, paused and stepped through document.getAnimations() in the demo iframe. The cubic-bezier editor and the lanes are drawn from the app's own code and styles (EasingPage.tsx, index.css), not captured.

steps.note: ripple: before

steps.js: (() => { const d = document.querySelector('.frame__iframe').contentDocument; const b = d.querySelector('button'), r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); for (const ty of ['pointerdown', 'pointerup']) b.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(ty, {bubbles: true, clientX: r.left + r.width * 0.3, clientY: r.top + r.height * 0.5})); b.click(); d.getAnimations().forEach(a => a.pause()); })()
